name: print-social-orange-glass-icon-four-step-figma-tutorial
title: Orange Glass Icon Four-Step Tutorial
whatItIs: A 2x2 grid tutorial in handwritten script: two grey frames, a gradient fill, a glass effect with shadows and property panels, and the finished orange glass 'i' icon.
whatItMeans: Small panel screenshots and hand-written notes feel like a designer's sketchbook. The build-up to the glowing final tile is satisfying.
techniques: Four equal cells that build progressively
Handwritten bullet notes over a clean grey field
Callout arrows pointing to real UI property panels
Final cell shown fully rendered as a reward

vocabulary.definition: A translucent, refractive treatment applied to a shape.
A curved arrow linking a note to a specific control.
A grid where each cell adds to the previous one.
